papers.key_result: Closed-form fractional-Kelly rules k*=Σ⁻¹(μ−r), k_α=ασ⁻¹…; L(k_α)=r+(α−α²/2)S², V(k_α)=α²S². VFIAX/VUSUX 2001–2021: fractional Kelly growth 0.089/SD 0.176/drawdown 41.9%/$576,464 vs full Kelly 0.172/0.594/89.8%/$3,002,829.
papers.title: Fractional Growth Portfolio Investment

papers.key_result: Continuous-time mean–VaR/mean–ES portfolio choice for log-returns; mean-ES payoff continuous in the state-price density (three-state structure); concave finite mean-ES frontier vs ill-posed min-VaR.
papers.title: Dynamic growth-optimum portfolio choice under risk control

papers.key_result: Laplace plug-in Kelly: per-race learning penalty (M−1)/(2t), cumulative regret (M−1)/2·log t; learning time t*=(M−1)/(2·D_KL(p‖r)); Cover's universal portfolio reduces exactly to Laplace.
papers.title: Adaptive strategies in Kelly's horse races model

papers.key_result: Distributionally-robust Kelly over a Wasserstein ball on empirical log-return distributions with exact convex reformulation; OOS 2020–2023 (train 2019, 10 random S&P500 stocks, 1000 reps, δ∈{0.1,…,0.4}) improves return/vol/Sharpe/drawdown/log-final-value vs standard Kelly (results graphical, no tables).
papers.title: Wasserstein-Kelly Portfolios

papers.key_result: Mixtures of arms are optimal for distortion risk measures (counterexample to arm-optimality); PM-ETC-M/PM-UCB-M/CIRT with ε-independent regret bounds (Thm 5: O(K^c_E(log T/T^γ)^{q·2β/(2β+q)})); CIRT anytime refinement beats fixed discretization on compute.
papers.title: Preference-centric Bandits: Optimality of Mixtures and Regret-efficient Algorithms

papers.key_result: STaR (Sequential Target-Recalculating) betting: recompute bets from remaining rounds and remaining wealth target; STaR-Hoeffding never worse than Hoeffding (Prop 4); first betting-based CI with proven 1+o(1)-optimal fixed-horizon width (Thm 8, Alg 3); Alg 4 (STaR-Bets) empirically near randomized Clopper-Pearson / T-test.
papers.title: STaR-Bets: Sequential Target-Recalculating Bets for Tighter Confidence Intervals

papers.key_result: Kelly with European-put hedge (KO) over binomial model; under correct specification options add nothing (no-arbitrage); convex mixture KOc of two KO strategies under different beliefs has asymptotic growth = max of the two components (Thm 4.1), claimed to dominate KS asymptotically ('estimation risk fully eliminated').
papers.title: Tackling estimation risk in Kelly investing using options

papers.key_result: Exact single-event multinomial full-Kelly solution: cash c_A=(1−P_A)/(1−Q_A), stakes x_i*=(p_i−c*q_i)_+, greedy support rule sorting edge ratios r_i=p_i/q_i, terminal wealth W_i*=max(c*,p_i/q_i). No empirical validation.
papers.title: Single-Event Multinomial Full Kelly via Implicit State Positions

papers.key_result: Horizon-aware anytime-valid testing as Bellman DP over log-wealth vs deadline: ahead→sub-Kelly, on-schedule→Kelly, behind→aggressive/all-in (Thm 3.1, Props 3.4/3.6 Sanov bounds); DQN policy beats fixed betting baselines.
papers.title: Learning to Bet for Horizon-Aware Anytime-Valid Testing

papers.key_result: Frullani/Laplace factorization reduces multivariate binary Kelly objective evaluation from O(2^N) to O(TN); Newton-CG with max relative error 3.92e-7; sigmoidal shortfall scaling law y≈(1+Qe^{−B·Logit(x)})^{−1/v}; independent-bets assumption is the binding limitation.
papers.title: Efficient Multivariate Kelly Optimization Reveals Sigmoidal Scaling Laws

papers.key_result: Continuous-time identities: growth gap g*−g^π=½‖θ−σᵀπ‖²; objective E_P[log(X_T*/X_T^π)]=D_KL(P‖P^π) and subjective E_{P^π}[log(X_T^π/X_T*)]=D_KL(P^π‖P). Pure theory, no data.
papers.title: Objective and subjective entropy measures of portfolio suboptimality

papers.key_result: [AUDIT-MANDATED REPLACEMENT for bogus slot 2603.04864v1] PuLP/COIN 9-man FanDuel MLB integer program ($35k cap) on SaberSim data Jun 1–11 2019 (408 players): model's best lineup averaged 144.6 vs hindsight-optimal 251.9 (gap 107.3); projection-error stats mislabeled ('R-mean-squared' 0.19); no contest validation; stacking/90th-percentile projections proposed but untested.
papers.title: Optimizing Daily Fantasy Baseball Lineups: A Linear Programming Approach for Enhanced Accuracy
